items.q: Why is there a payment take on top of the subscription?
items.a: Because the take funds the moat. High-risk / merchant-of-record relationships for a restricted category cost real money to secure and maintain. 2.4–3.4% is what it costs to never again lose a quarter's income to a keyword scan — and it's a fraction of the 40–60% commission reading marketplaces charge.

items.q: Can I start on Hearth and move up?
items.a: Yes, any time, prorated. Most design partners start on Practice for the Voice model — it's the tier the platform is really built around — but Hearth is a complete storefront-and-payments practice on its own.
Two months free on annual plans. Founding cohort pricing ($29/$79, locked for life) beats every discount we'll ever run — which is rather the point of joining early.

items.q: What happens to my rate when Discover launches?
items.a: Nothing. The 10–20% network take applies only to clients who find you through Discover. Your existing book and anyone you bring stays at your payment tier — we never re-rate your own clients.
